title: Agreement of payloads away from the origin
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For every integer offset $z \ne 0$, the payload vector after the origin write under the totalized action of $M$ on $c$ equals the head-centered payload vector of $c$ at offset $z$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
c is a configuration of M on x
z is an integer with z ≠ 0
replaced:
For a binary machine $M$, a configuration $c$ of $M$, and any offset $z \neq 0$,
the written payload vector of $c$ under the totalized action of $M$ agrees at
$z$ with the head-centered payload vector of $c$.
